title: My watch told me to stand up 🔔
style_prompt: dark blue cinematic night, faceless silhouette, fog, minimal interior, no text, no watermark
hook_text: At 3:00 in the morning my watch told me to stand up and look behind me.

scenes.narration: At 3:00 in the morning my watch told me to stand up and look behind me.
It was the usual reminder, the one that says, time to move. But this one had a second line. Please look behind you.
I sat on the edge of the bed, in the dark. The watch buzzed again. You are doing it wrong. Stand up first.
I stood. My knees were shaking. The watch showed a tiny animation, a figure that stands, and turns, and waves.
Then it showed my heart rate. A hundred and twenty. It said, good, now turn, slowly.
I turned. The room was empty. The wardrobe door was open a hand's width. And inside the dark gap, something was standing as still as I was.
The watch buzzed one last time. Great job. Daily goal achieved. And from the dark gap in the wardrobe, I heard a tiny soft sound. A wrist, buzzing, in time with mine.
So tell me. Do you close the wardrobe, or leave the room?
